resources.string: Bigger files, longer messages, sharper screen share
Everything you need to talk is free. Mojo is for the big files, the long messages, the sharp streams and the badge.

Long stories, patch notes, a whole recipe: one message. Edits get the same room.
Full clips, big GIFs, whole albums. Files stay until you delete them, even if your plan ends.
Crisp and smooth for everyone watching.
A small badge next to your name so people know you keep the lights on. Hide it any time.
The Meldiq Check is a thank-you for Plus members. It doesn\'t verify who anyone is.
Give a Spark to a server you love. Every Spark helps unlock more emoji slots, bigger uploads, and better voice and screen sharing for everyone there.

Give one from a server\'s menu: Server menu, then Meldiq Spark.

Each pack is a monthly subscription in Google Play. You hold one pack at a time: switching changes it at once, and Google credits what\'s left of the old one. Extra Sparks stay yours if your plan ends.
Servers top out at Level 3: more Sparks on one server don\'t add anything. Keep extras for other servers.
One payment, straight onto their account, with a note from you. 1 month, 3 months or a year. It never renews.
They\'ll find it in Meldiq and start it whenever they like; it never renews. If they already have free Mojo time, the gift follows on after it.

Meldiq has no outside investors. We pay for the servers, storage, voice and video bandwidth, and the moderation and development tools that keep it running. Subscriptions help cover those real costs, and anything left helps us keep improving Meldiq. Talking with people stays free.
Still free for everyone: messages, voice and video calls, screen share, communities, emoji and stickers, polls, and end-to-end encryption.
Payment is taken by Google Play with the methods it offers in your country; Meldiq never sees your card. Subscriptions renew every month until you cancel in Google Play.
